race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: Harry Charlton 3-y-o THAT'S RANDOM might be worth siding with to resume his progression with his recent Leicester outing behind him. Modern Times was a bit better than the result when fifth at Kempton last month and is feared most back at the scene of his success in July. Fair Y Isle has a progressive profile on all-weather and could also play a part if fully primed after a break. THAT'S RANDOM MODERN TIMES FAIR Y ISLE
